name: ENCODE — GRCh38 alignments
description: Released files from the ENCODE portal, each named by its unsigned object on the encode-public bucket. Built from ENCODE's own daily file manifest and joined to the biosample, assay and target of the experiment it belongs to. The portal is not contacted when this store is opened.
